meta.name: lsp
meta.description: Use when Codex needs language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or rename safety checks in the current workspace.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在编辑器中获取代码诊断、定义跳转和引用查找
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在代码编辑器中快速定位定义、引用或检查重命名安全
copy.tagline_en: Get language diagnostics, definitions, references, and rename safety in your editor
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick access to definitions, references, and rename safety in your code editor

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能调用编程语言分析工具:帮你查代码报错、跳到定义处、找出引用位置、查看符号,以及安全地重命名。
howto.when: 当你在当前项目里需要代码诊断、跳转定义、查找引用等语言服务能力时,Claude 会通过这些工具帮你完成。

say.text: 帮我看看这个文件有没有编译错误。
say.note: 触发 lsp.diagnostics,返回诊断结果。

say.text: 这个函数是在哪里定义的?
say.note: 触发 lsp.goto_definition 跳到定义位置。

say.text: 我重命名这个变量会影响哪些地方?

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can use language-server tools to report code errors, jump to symbol definitions, find usages, inspect symbols, and safely rename identifiers.
howto.when_en: Claude activates these tools when you need code diagnostics, definition jumps, or reference lookups in the current project.

say_en.text: Check this file for compilation errors.

say_en.note: Triggers lsp.goto_definition to locate the definition.

say_en.text: Would renaming this variable affect other places?
